services.name: First-dance lesson
services.story: The same $179 first-dance lesson, paid in full when booking, as some teachers ask. A $150 class at a preschool, school or senior center is paid in full this way too.

services_shape: class: a spot in a set class time by style, age group and level, with a set number of spots, a few trial spots and a waitlist; each dancer booked is checked in on their own. Private lessons book one teacher, at the studio or a home. A class at a host's place (a preschool, a school, a senior center) books a teacher's time for a group
questions_before_times: who is dancing: the parent's own child, or the adult themselves
for a child: the age (it sets the age group) and the style (ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop)
danced before? which style, and for how long (it sets the level; a trained dancer is placed by Sam)
for a private or wedding lesson: the goal, and at the studio or at home
for a class at a host's place: how many dancers, their ages, and the place
safety_stop: someone hurt or unwell right now: a hard fall, a head injury, an ankle they can't stand on, fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing
first_steps: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
license: from the state form: teaching dance usually needs no state license; some places register a dance studio, or set rules for selling classes ahead (a bond, a written contract, a cancel right)
staff_skills: ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop, contemporary, ballroom and wedding dances; Creative Movement for ages 3 to 5
messages_never: a child's last name, age, health notes, allergies, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the class, and link to the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
